random_seed: 12 fixed seeds 0..11; mean +/- std reported across seeds

outputs.metric: common_source.incr_over_poor.mean (incremental CV-R2 of co-skewness over a directed-FC baseline)
common_source.incr_over_static.mean (incremental CV-R2 of co-skewness over static linear FC)
independent_source.coskew_alone.mean (CV-R2 of co-skewness alone, no common driver)

known_limitations: Synthetic generative model, not real fMRI/HCP. By construction it contains NO genuine instantaneous three-way coupling term; it demonstrates only that a lagged common skewed driver is SUFFICIENT to produce a cognition-predictive static co-skewness that a directed-FC baseline absorbs. It cannot establish which regime real BOLD data occupy. Ridge alpha fixed at 1.0; a single common driver and one symmetric nuisance; 4 nodes; haemodynamic spread approximated by a shared fixed lag-1..3 kernel rather than region-specific HRFs. The residual increment of co-skewness over a richer directed baseline on real data was reported as small but run-to-run unstable in the duel transcript and is NOT resolved here.
